## How it was tested / 怎麼測的

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests -q`
- [ ] `python tools/dev/release_check.py --base origin/main`
- [ ] A new tool has a test in `tests/` and a row in both READMEs' tool tables / 新工具有測試，兩份 README 的工具表都有一列
- [ ] Changes to the method are in `CHANGELOG.md` in both languages / 方法的改動已用中英文寫進 `CHANGELOG.md`
